name: List Documents
description: Lists documents for a given extractor by reading extraction records (GET /v1/extracted_data/{extractorId}) and returning their `documentId` and `fileName`, deduplicated by `documentId`. AlgoDocs has no dedicated documents endpoint, so this action derives the document list from extracted data. Use it to discover a valid `documentId` before configuring **New Extracted Data**. Run **List Extractors** to find a valid extractor ID first. [See the documentation](https://api.algodocs.com/).
